name: Auth & Admin Dashboard
description: Verifies the sign-up modal opens, login form renders with email and password fields, and admin dashboard loads with stats and navigation after login.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Sign Up' or account icon in the navigation
Verify a sign-up or login modal/form appears with email and password input fields
Verify the user is logged in and redirected or the navigation shows a profile/admin link
Navigate to the admin dashboard URL by appending '/admin' to the base URL
Verify the admin dashboard loads with stats cards showing numbers and a sidebar with navigation links for Products, Orders, and Gallery
